The main takeaway from our work is that
the AMPT partonic stage can be viewed as a hybrid between a pure cascade (like MPC) and an equilibrating parton transport.

the partonic stage in AMPT generates a large elliptic flow through the combination of (a) a large initial eccentricity in the partonic system, (b) a large parton scattering cross section, (c) a large partonic lifetime, and (d) a small transverse flow in the initial partonic system.
